meta.project_name: Nova Konut — Organization / Team Network Visualization
meta.visual_tone: Old Money Corporate, Architectural Blueprint Elegance, Serious, Premium Minimalist
anti_patterns_strictly_forbidden: No cheap gold gradient fills or diamond ornamental icons
No monogram/initial tiles or square photo avatar boxes
No card grids or solid boxed containers
No default tech rounded cards or generic dashboard borders
No high-contrast neon or bright vibrant accent colors
No fast, bouncy or flashy animations

layout_and_structure.concept: Chic Linear Org-Chart / Network Tree Visualization
layout_and_structure.description: Replace all 4-column card grid boxes with an elegant, architectural network tree where names exist as pure typographic text nodes connected by delicate SVG or CSS connecting lines and subtle node junction dots.

typographic_node.container: display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: relative; padding: 12px 16px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(154,130,83,0.3); transition: all 0.3s ease;

motion_and_interactions.hover_transitions: transition: border-color 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
motion_and_interactions.line_pulse: Subtle stroke opacity change on node hover (0.18 to 0.7)
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Gentle fade-in with 20px upward translation on viewport intersection

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep header, navbar, footer, side-menu, utility bar and team hero header intact in team.html.
2. Remove all square cards (.tm-card) and monogram tiles (.tm-tile, .tm-monogram) completely from team.html.
3. Implement the network visualization tree in team.html using pure typographic nodes (name in Cormorant Garamond, role in Montserrat) connected with hairline stroke lines.
4. Ensure each section/group corresponds to the 4 departments in order: Management, Construction & Engineering, Architecture & Design, Finance & Legal.

5. Preserve all key data-testid attributes: team-page-title, team-group-management, team-card-management-1..4, team-group-construction-and-engineering, team-card-construction-and-engineering-1..3, team-group-architecture-and-design, team-card-architecture-and-design-1..3, team-group-finance-and-legal, team-card-finance-and-legal-1..4.
6. Update frontend/css/team.css with refined architectural line network styling, ivory background #f4f1ea, graphite text #1b1a17, and bronze connectors #9a8253.
7. Optionally add an SVG connector script or CSS grid tree lines in frontend/js/script.js to dynamically trace clean SVG connecting paths between departmental nodes and member nodes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_principles: Avoid generic AI slop. Prioritize human-directed architectural restraint, generous whitespace, sharp hairline dividers, and pure typographic elegance.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all body roles and 3:1 for large display titles against #f4f1ea background.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive: On mobile viewports (<768px), transition the multi-column network tree into a clean vertical timeline network with a continuous 1px bronze stroke on the left.
